title: ClaudeOS task-context manifest
description: A named, durable, git-tracked working context (Phase 3). A manifest describes the TOOLS and PLACES of a workspace — not pixel-perfect app state. Written by `claudeos-context save` (snapshotting the live workspace) or by a lane via `claudeos_context_emit` (agent preparation). Read back by `claudeos-context restore`, which reassembles it into a named Hyprland workspace.

name.description: Human-readable context name (e.g. "refinance"). The filesystem slug is derived from it.

created.description: Unix epoch of first save; preserved across re-saves.

updated.description: Unix epoch of the most recent save.

notes.description: Free-form note carried with the context ("waiting on payoff letter").

items.description: The tools and places to reassemble. Order is preserved on restore.

class.description: Hyprland window class — used to skip an app already present on restore (idempotency).

argv.description: The relaunch vector. argv[0] is a bare command name (basenamed off any /nix/store path, so it survives rebuilds); /nix/store path arguments are stripped, durable flags (URLs, --app=…) are kept.

title.description: The window title at save time — best-effort provenance only, never used to relaunch.

urls.description: Best-effort browser URLs (v1: window titles only; a real tab integration is out of scope).

cwd.description: The working directory of a shell that was running in a terminal on the workspace.

cmd.description: Optional command to run in the restored terminal instead of an interactive shell.

path.description: A file to xdg-open on restore. Not auto-detected by save in v1 — added by a lane or by hand (the manifest is editable git-tracked text).
